VBO:0200844.summary: Affectionate and sensitive to handling in the National Kennel Club standard, the Majestic Tree Hound is a substantial hound built to cover ground. The standard calls for an easy, free-moving gait and a dense short coat suited to rough conditions.
VBO:0200844.shortDescription: Affectionate and sensitive in its NKC standard, the Majestic Tree Hound combines a substantial frame with free movement.

sources.title: National Kennel Club — Majestic Tree Hound standard
sources.evidence: Entire actual retained own standard reread. Affectionate and sensitive to kindness/correction; powerful ground-covering hound, long square foreface, very long low soft folded ears, hanging flews/dewlap, substantial functional limbs/knuckled feet, long high-set tapering natural stern with underside hair, dense short coat. No universal peaceful/safety claim adopted. Correction review 2026-10-06: Independently read substantive standard 2026-10-06: affectionate/sensitive temperament, free swinging elastic movement and short thick coat with rough-condition function. Universal peacefulness and dog/child safety claims omitted. No Bull/Tank anecdote used to establish the type.
